positions.title: Connections Program Ambassador
positions.description: Mentor students on underrepresented backgrounds to help promote diversity and inclusion in STEM. Program Ambassador Lead for 2025-2026 school year.

positions.title: Global School Social Media Manager
positions.description: Manage Instagram and Facebook accounts for the WPI Puerto Rico Project Center through the Global School

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Clara, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Create a user-space program capable of parsing and executing cryptographic test vectors formatted according to the NIST Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP) specifications. Interface with cryptographic hardware modules using the PKCS#11 API, automating the process of loading, running, and validating test cases across supported cryptographic algorithms.

positions.title: Technology & Innovation Specialist Intern
positions.description: Conducted a mock migration of two years of bank data from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA in preparation for a full ERP system upgrade, including general ledger values, contracts, and real estate records. Created and managed 200+ validation and reconciliation templates using PowerQuery to verify data extraction and loading accuracy, collaborating with 15+ business users across 6 departments and external contractors. Identified errors across 15% of the migrated data as a result of the migration pipeline.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed regression testing for Power Protect Data Manager (PPDM), an application handling data backups and restores for Linux and Windows file systems. Automated a series of tests which check that file backups are run and restored correctly for Windows machines, which are used to ensure future release features do not interfere with parallel backup functionality. Decreased testing time from 8 hours manually to 2 hours automatically, increasing efficiency of development. Nominated for internal INSPIRE award by manager, recognizing exemplary intern work.

positions.title: Summer Education Staff
positions.description: Develop and execute summer camp curriculum covering welding, laser cutting, 3D printing, soldering and electronic circuits. Assisted in the assembly of a mobile rapid prototyping lab intended for use in remote areas.

positions.title: Programming Lead
positions.description: Collaborate with programming team members to write and test robot code developed in Java. Coordinate with programmers and other team members to organize a schedule for testing the robot. Teach new subteam members about writing robot code and provide support and direction as necessary.  Introduce new team members to the team.

positions.title: FRC 5587 Member
positions.description: Provide technical and non-technical support for the team. Troubleshoot mechanical and electrical problems, while assisting in the design and fabrication of the robot. Established STEM programs within the City of Alexandria and attended over 40 hours of outreach events as a team member. Participate in outreach events in our community regularly.

positions.title: Marketing Lead
positions.description: Created social media posts, designed team merchandise, maintained team branding image, and communicated with local news companies for articles and press releases. Collaborated with other team members to develop and transmit marketing posts for fundraising and outreach events. Trained others in marketing and delegated tasks.

positions.title: Java Camp Director
positions.description: Organized online Introduction to Java camp (targeted towards middle schoolers) and translated curriculum into an online format. Taught live lessons and served as a resource to the students.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description: Inspect MARi web app and report problems seen within the application. Use tools such as Clubhouse and Zeplin to help further to functionality of the app.
